(B) 9am to 12pm
(C) 5pm to 7pm
(D) 12pm to 5pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)
cot:

- Thomas was seen by Linda from 9am to 12pm.

- Thomas was seen by Lisa from 7pm to 10pm.

The restaurant was closed after 10pm, so Thomas could not have gone to the restaurant between 10pm and 12pm. Therefore, the overlapping times from Linda and Susan do not include the restaurant hours, but the overlapping times from Susan and Lisa do include the restaurant hours.

The overlapping times from Susan (5pm to 7pm) and Lisa (7pm to 10pm) include the restaurant hours. Thus, Thomas could have gone to the restaurant between 5pm and 10pm.
